choices.reason: No rule separates the candidates: the paper names none of clarity, informativeness, or relevance as primary, and all three have participant-level data_stats for the same first-round arms and sample. Rule 2 cannot select among different outcomes; the other rules provide no distinction, and the linked preregistration could not be verified because OSF and repository API requests failed.
